name: Credit cover request type code
description: Code specifying the type of request for credit cover.

values.name: Multi-currency credit cover
values.description: Multi-currency credit cover Invoices in currencies other than the currency of the credit cover are expected.

values.name: Request new limit
values.description: Request new limit Seller requests new limit.

values.name: Request increased limit
values.description: Request increased limit Seller requests increase of existing limit.

values.name: Request for preliminary assessment
values.description: Request for preliminary assessment Request for information to be used during negotiation with prospective clients (sellers).

values.name: Request for new account only
values.description: Request for new account only Request for opening new account only.

values.name: Cancellation
values.description: Cancellation Request to cancel an existing credit cover.

values.name: Reduction
values.description: Reduction Request to reduce an existing credit cover.

values.name: Prolongation of credit cover
values.description: Prolongation of credit cover Request to prolong an existing credit cover.
